name: 70437 · Folsom, LA
findings: ZIP 70437 (Folsom) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70437 (Folsom) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
